dialog_history.content: Where is the swelling exactly (e.g., face/lips/eyelids/neck/throat vs one arm/leg vs generalized), and did it start suddenly or gradually?
The swelling is mainly in my legs and feet—both ankles, the left thigh, the left top of the foot, and the right sole. It started kind of suddenly, not gradually.
Did you have any trouble breathing, chest pain/pressure, or a new cough or wheezing around the time the leg/foot swelling started?
No, I haven’t had trouble breathing, chest pain or pressure, and no new cough or wheezing around the time it started.
Is the leg swelling painful or warm (especially in the left thigh), and have you noticed any redness or one leg being more swollen than the other?

It is painful, and it feels like a tedious kind of pain, especially around the left thigh. I don’t think it’s warm or red, and yes—the swelling seems a bit more on the left side (left thigh and left top of the foot) than the right.
Have you had any recent long travel or prolonged sitting, recent surgery/immobility, or a history of blood clots (DVT/PE) in yourself or close family?
No recent long travel or prolonged sitting. I did have surgery to remove lymph nodes in the past, but not recently, and I don’t know of any history of blood clots in me or close family.
Do you have any fever or chills, and have you noticed any shortness of breath or coughing up blood (even if the leg swelling is the main symptom)?
No fever or chills. And no shortness of breath or coughing up blood.
Do you notice any skin color change over the swollen areas (redness, warmth, pale/blue/purple discoloration) or any numbness/tingling in the legs/feet?
No noticeable redness or warmth, and no pale/blue/purple discoloration that I’ve seen. I also haven’t noticed numbness or tingling in my legs or feet.
Do you have any visible swelling of the veins (or a “rope-like” vein), and does pressing on the swollen area leave a dent (pitting) or is it firm/non-pitting?
I haven’t noticed any visible rope-like veins. When I press on the swollen areas, I think it leaves a dent—so it seems like pitting.
Do you have any numbness/tingling, weakness, or severe pain in the leg/foot (especially the left thigh), and does the pain get worse when you walk or press on the area?
No numbness or tingling, and no weakness. The pain is there and feels tedious, and it seems worse when I walk and when I press on the left thigh area.
Have you had any recent infection or skin injury on either leg/foot (cuts, wounds, insect bites), or any new urinary symptoms, abdominal pain, or diarrhea in the past 2–4 weeks?
No recent infection or skin injury on my legs or feet—no cuts, wounds, or insect bites. And I haven’t had new urinary symptoms, abdominal pain, or diarrhea in the past 2–4 weeks.

Have you had any recent changes in medications or hormones (especially testosterone/androgen therapy, estrogen, birth-control–type hormones), and are you currently taking any blood thinners (or aspirin/NSAIDs) or have any known clotting/autoimmune conditions?

I haven’t had hormone changes like testosterone or other androgen therapy. I am taking anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs). I’m not on any blood thinners, and I don’t know of any clotting or autoimmune conditions.

Have you had any recent cancer diagnosis or treatment, or any known thrombophilia (clotting disorder) in you or close relatives—such as Factor V Leiden, protein C/S deficiency, antithrombin deficiency, or antiphospholipid syndrome?

No recent cancer diagnosis or treatment. And I don’t know of any known thrombophilia like Factor V Leiden, protein C/S deficiency, antithrombin deficiency, or antiphospholipid syndrome in me or close relatives.
Have you had any recent respiratory illness (sore throat, cough, wheezing) in the last 2–4 weeks, or any new fever, and do you have any swollen lymph nodes or unexplained weight loss?
No recent respiratory illness in the last 2–4 weeks, and no new fever. I don’t know of any swollen lymph nodes, and I haven’t had unexplained weight loss—I actually gained weight recently.
Have you noticed any new redness or pain in one eye, eye pain with light sensitivity, mouth or genital ulcers, or a new rash/joint pains since the leg swelling started?
No new redness or pain in one eye, no eye pain with light sensitivity. No mouth or genital ulcers, and no new rash or joint pains since the leg swelling started.
Have you had any recent immobilization beyond travel—such as bed rest, casting/splinting, or significantly reduced mobility for more than 4–6 weeks (even if you weren’t traveling)?
No, I haven’t been immobilized or on bed rest, and no casting or splinting. My mobility hasn’t been significantly reduced for more than 4–6 weeks.

It started recently—about 5 days ago, in the afternoon (around 3–5 PM). Since then it’s been more or less getting worse rather than improving.

When did the intense coughing fits start, and how long have they lasted so far—are they happening in episodes (with periods of normal breathing in between) or is the cough continuous all day?

The intense coughing fits started pretty fast—about 6/10 for how quickly it began. They come in episodes: I have coughing fits, and then there are times when my breathing feels more normal before the next fit.
During these coughing-fit episodes, do you notice any wheezing or noisy breathing (like a whistling sound), shortness of breath, or any “whoop” sound right after coughing?
I don’t know about wheezing or a whistling sound. I also haven’t noticed any “whoop” sound right after coughing, and I don’t feel short of breath during the fits.
Is the cough dry or does it bring up mucus/phlegm—if there’s mucus, what color is it (clear/white/yellow/green/bloody)?
The cough feels like it’s mostly dry for me. I’m not bringing up any mucus or phlegm, and I haven’t noticed any blood.
Has he had a fever (what’s the highest temperature), and does he have any sore throat, runny nose, or nasal congestion—if so, did those start before the coughing fits or after?
I don’t have a fever that I know of, and I don’t have a sore throat, runny nose, or nasal congestion. These symptoms started mainly with the coughing fits.
Does he have any trouble breathing during the coughing fits—such as chest pulling in (retractions), fast breathing, or noisy breathing/stridor (a high-pitched sound when breathing in)?
No—during the coughing fits I don’t have trouble breathing like chest pulling in, and I don’t have noisy breathing or a high-pitched stridor sound. Breathing is okay between the coughing episodes.
How many coughing fits/episodes does he have in a day, and do they seem worse at night or triggered by things like running/crying, cold air, laughing, or eating?

I can’t say the exact number of fits in a day, but they are happening in episodes. They seem worse when I cough hard, and I think they’re not only from night or from running/crying/cold air/laughing/eating—it's mainly the coughing fits themselves.
Has he vomited after coughing (or does he ever gag/choke during the coughing fits), and does he seem completely well/normal between episodes?
No, he hasn’t vomited after coughing, and he doesn’t gag or choke during the fits. Between episodes he seems more normal, like the breathing settles down.
Has anyone around him been sick recently (at school/daycare or at home), and do you know if he had any exposure to someone with pertussis (“whooping cough”) or tuberculosis?
I don’t know if anyone around him has been sick recently. I also don’t know about exposure to pertussis or tuberculosis.
Is he up to date on his routine childhood vaccines (especially DTaP/pertussis), and has he missed any doses in the last year?
I’m not sure if he’s up to date on DTaP/pertussis, and I don’t know if he missed any doses in the last year.

Does he have any smoke exposure at home (cigarettes/wood burning), any pets or mold in the house, or has he had any choking/possible aspiration (like food or a small object) around the time the coughing fits started?
I don’t know about smoke exposure, pets, or mold. I also don’t think there was any choking or possible aspiration from food or a small object around when the coughing fits started.
During the coughing fits, does his face or lips ever look blue/gray (cyanosis), and can he cry or speak normally between fits?
No, his face or lips don’t look blue/gray to me. And between the coughing fits he can cry and talk normally.
During the coughing fits, does he ever make a “whoop” sound when he inhales afterward, or does he ever cough so hard that he can’t catch his breath for a moment?
No, I haven’t noticed a “whoop” sound after coughing. He can catch his breath again, and the coughing fits don’t last so long that he can’t breathe for a moment.
Has he had any recent weight loss, night sweats, or persistent cough that’s been going on for more than 2 weeks (even if it comes in episodes)?
I don’t know about weight loss or night sweats. His cough has been going on for less than 2 weeks for me, and it comes in episodes rather than all day.
Does he have any heartburn, sour taste/regurgitation, or symptoms that seem to start after meals or when lying down (even if he doesn’t complain of “sore throat”)?
No, he doesn’t have heartburn or a sour taste/regurgitation. It doesn’t seem to start after meals or when he’s lying down.

It started pretty fast—more sudden than gradual, about 5/10 in onset speed. It’s been going on since then and feels like about 5/10 right now; it’s mostly in the center of my upper chest, and it seems worse when I cough. I don’t think it’s worse when I take a deep breath or when I move my body.
Do you have any cough or shortness of breath right now—if yes, is the cough dry or are you bringing up any sputum (and what color), and have you had any fever or chills?
Yes, I have a cough right now. It feels more like a dry cough—I’m not bringing up any sputum. I don’t have fever or chills.
Do you have any shortness of breath (especially with walking or climbing stairs), wheezing, or any swelling/pain in one leg or recent long travel/immobility?

I do feel short of breath, especially when I’m walking or if I lie down—I notice it more when I’m flat (that makes it harder to breathe). I don’t have wheezing, and I don’t have swelling or pain in one leg. I haven’t had recent long travel or been immobile.
Do you have any of these with the chest pain or shortness of breath: sweating, nausea/vomiting, palpitations (feeling your heart racing/irregular), fainting/lightheadedness, or coughing up blood?
No to sweating. I don’t feel nauseated or vomiting, and I don’t have palpitations or feel like I might faint. And no, I’m not coughing up blood.
Have you had any sore throat, hoarseness, trouble swallowing, or a sensation of throat swelling/stridor (noisy breathing), and did your symptoms start after a recent cold or sick contact?
